source_title: LakeSail Announces Partnership with Oxide Computer Company to Advance Secure, Cost-Efficient Private Clouds
source_excerpt:
Partnership enables enterprises to run AI workloads on validated, customer-owned infrastructure.
EMERYVILLE, Calif. , Oct. 30, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- LakeSail announced a strategic partnership with Oxide Computer Company to help enterprises modernize data and AI infrastructure while maintaining control over security, performance, and cost.
The partnership follows the successful validation of Sail on Oxide's platform. Sail, LakeSail's open-source, Rust-native, Spark-compatible compute engine, ran on Oxide's integrated, rack-scale cloud platform, establishing a validated foundation for secure, customer-controlled AI environments.
Oxide delivers a cloud-like experience within a customer's data center through an integrated platform and unified control plane. Its architecture includes a hardware root of trust and mechanisms for verifying the integrity of the software stack.
Sail preserves Spark APIs, SQL, and DataFrames while replacing the traditional JVM execution layer with a Rust-native architecture. It supports Python, Apache Iceberg, and Delta Lake, allowing enterprises to modernize without rewriting existing applications.
By eliminating the JVM execution layer, Sail reduces costs and performance bottlenecks associated with cluster startup, garbage collection, memory tuning, idle capacity, and overprovisioning. Depending on workload and configuration, LakeSail has demonstrated performance improvements of up to 10x and infrastructure-cost reductions of up to 98% compared with equivalent Spark and JVM-based deployments.
Enterprises can use Sail as open-source software or purchase the commercial LakeSail Platform for management, governance, security, and support capabilities.
"We believe data processing and AI belong in the same engine rather than in separate systems customers must stitch together," said Shehab Amin, Co-Founder and CEO of LakeSail. "Combining Sail's efficiency with Oxide's customer-owned cloud infrastructure gives enterprises more freedom to build without inheriting more complexity or traditional JVM economics."
"As data management and processing become more central to AI, we're excited to see LakeSail running on Oxide," said Steve Tuck, Co-Founder and CEO of Oxide Computer Company. "Running LakeSail's modern execution engine on Oxide's on-prem Cloud Computer allows customers to gain insights from their data faster while maintaining the control over where that data lives."
Sail is available as open-source software. The LakeSail Platform and Oxide Cloud Computers are sold and supported separately. Validated configurations are available for qualified enterprise evaluations. Contact [email protected] .
LakeSail is the company behind Sail and the commercial LakeSail Platform. LakeSail was co-founded by Shehab Amin and Heran Lin. Learn more: lakesail.com .
